verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents a REST API that it says supports every operation available in the web client, with OAuth 2.0 auth, so an agent could query invoices, customers and receivables directly. There is no agent-native interface, though: no MCP server or machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found, and specific metrics like MRR or upcoming renewals are not documented as queryable. missing for 10: official MCP server or agent tooling, published OpenAPI spec, documented endpoints for MRR, delinquency and renewal queries, hands-on corroboration of an agent answering billing questions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
Zoho REST APIs uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate calls.
Unlock insights on sales, receivables, expenses & more.
